helper.callFailed: The call failed. Retry for free.
helper.purchaseFailed: Could not purchase the helper. Check your platinum balance and game state.
helper.bonusRisk: Risk your gold star on the secret 16th question? Win to keep gold and earn platinum; lose and forfeit that gold. No hints or helper calls in this round.
